segments.text: THe next thing to be handled is, The excellent properties of this Rest, and admirable Attributes, which, as so many Jewels, shall adorn the Crown of the Saints. And first before we speak of them particularly, let us try this Happiness by the Rules of the Philosopher, and see whether they will not approve it the more transcendently Good: Not as if they were a sufficient Touchstone; but that both the Worldling and the Saint may see, when any thing stands up in competition with this Glory for the preheminence, Reason it self will conclude against it. Now, in order of good, the Philosopher will tell you, that by these Rules you may know which is Best.
